achievements.name: Chosen Weapon
achievements.detail: Choose Veredicto, Ruego Al Alba, or Sarmiento & Centella where the pilgrimage begins.

achievements.name: Prie Dieu
achievements.detail: Rest at a Prie Dieu to save, recover, and refill your Bile Flasks.

achievements.name: Faceless One
achievements.detail: Defeat the Faceless One, Chisel of Oblivion, the first boss on the road.

achievements.name: Mark of Martyrdom
achievements.detail: Take a Mark of Martyrdom from a boss you have defeated.

achievements.name: Blessed Name
achievements.detail: Enter the City of the Blessed Name beyond the opening ravine.

achievements.name: Freed Cherub
achievements.detail: Free a Cherub you find trapped along the pilgrimage.

achievements.name: Altarpiece
achievements.detail: Set a figure into the Altarpiece of Favours on the Penitent One's back.

achievements.name: Answered Prayer
achievements.detail: Equip a prayer and call on it during a fight.

achievements.name: Rosary Bead
achievements.detail: Equip a rosary bead so its blessing travels with you.

achievements.name: Second Weapon
achievements.detail: Find a weapon you did not take when the pilgrimage began.

achievements.name: Three Weapons
achievements.detail: Obtain Veredicto, Ruego Al Alba, and Sarmiento & Centella.

achievements.name: Final Devotion
achievements.detail: Win the last battle of the Penitent One's pilgrimage.
